subject: Workplace Skills
title: Acute Stress vs Chronic Stress
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Acute Stress vs Chronic Stress.

hook.text: A deadline in two hours is acute stress. Feeling like every week is a crisis for months is chronic stress.

buildup.text: Acute stress sharpens focus and boosts performance. Cortisol mobilizes energy and narrows attention.

discovery.text: Chronic stress does the opposite. Sustained cortisol impairs memory, weakens immunity, and damages judgment.

twist.text: Many professionals mistake chronic stress for dedication. They wear exhaustion as a badge of commitment.

climax.text: Monitor whether your stress is episodic or continuous. If it never fully subsides, the system needs changing.

punchline.text: Short stress sharpens. Long stress destroys. Know which.

quiz.question: What is the key difference between acute and chronic stress?
options: Acute stress is emotional; chronic stress is physical
Acute stress sharpens focus; chronic stress impairs it
Chronic stress only affects older workers
